articles.title: Methamphetamine: Mechanism, History, Clinical Use, and Tolerance
articles.core_mechanism: N-methyl addition on the phenylethylamine backbone markedly elevates lipophilicity and BBB penetration, yielding ~5x greater central dopamine release than amphetamine with greater DAT selectivity at therapeutic oral doses (Desoxyn). PKC-driven DAT phosphorylation reverses transporter flux while blocking reuptake. Rapid high-dose smoking/injection collapses the VMAT2 vesicular H+ gradient, dumping cytosolic DA and generating neurotoxic ROS—a regime absent at low oral clinical doses.
articles.tolerance_chain: Repeated D1 Gs/PKA -> phospho-CREB -> DeltaFosB accumulation -> CDK5/p35 transcription -> DARPP-32 Thr75 phosphorylation (turns DARPP-32 into a PKA inhibitor, starving Thr34-P and unleashing PP1), alongside fast GRK2/beta-arrestin2 clathrin endocytosis.
articles.epistemic_notes: Therapeutic oral Desoxyn vs smoked crystal methamphetamine differ fundamentally in pharmacokinetics (dC/dt) and VMAT2 alkalization; last dedicated Desoxyn ADHD trial dates to ~1972.

articles.title: Why Methamphetamine Is Safer Than Amphetamine — Cardiovascularly
articles.core_mechanism: Lower-lipophilicity amphetamine (especially Adderall's 25% levoamphetamine fraction) distributes more heavily into peripheral sympathetic tissue, driving alpha1 vasoconstriction and beta1 tachycardia. Methamphetamine's N-methyl group partitions centrally across the BBB with higher DAT-over-NET selectivity. Approximately 15-30% of methamphetamine is metabolized via CYP2D6 into amphetamine, explaining why cardiovascular stimulation often rises hours later as the parent peak clears into its noradrenergic metabolite.
articles.epistemic_notes: Applies strictly to supervised therapeutic oral dosing in severe treatment-resistant ADHD—methamphetamine carries far higher central addiction potential due to its >5x dopamine differential.

articles.title: Dopamine: Synthesis, Regional Gating, D.A.R.E. Failure & Permanent Tolerance
articles.core_mechanism: Synthesis runs Tyrosine -> (TH) -> L-DOPA -> (AADC + Vitamin B6 cofactor) -> Dopamine, explaining why B6 has clinical utility in antipsychotic D2-blockade akathisia. Dopamine's function is anatomical: PFC (working memory/planning), NAc (salience/reward), dorsal striatum (habit/compulsion). Generic 'drugs are bad' education fails because it hides the irreversible circuit shift from VTA->NAc reward to dorsal-striatal habit lock driven by DeltaFosB -> CDK5 -> DARPP-32 Thr75-P. Conversely, SSRIs (e.g., sertraline/Zoloft) harness the same GRK2/beta-arrestin adaptation in reverse: acute SERT block activates somatodendritic 5-HT1A autoreceptors that brake raphe firing until multi-week 5-HT1A downregulation unlocks full serotonergic output.
articles.epistemic_notes: Animal microdialysis benchmarks (~200% orgasm, 300-500% cocaine, up to 2,600% high-dose methamphetamine) reflect acute rodent NAc dialysate peaks.

articles.title: The Standard ADHD Model Is Incomplete (Maladaptive NMDA Homeostat)
articles.core_mechanism: Low DA/NE alone causes lethargy, apathy, and low blood pressure (as in anhedonic MDD), NOT hyperactivity. In true severe neurochemical ADHD, impaired presynaptic catecholamine release triggers maladaptive compensatory NMDA receptor hyperexcitability (H_NMDA) attempting to force DA release. Because vesicular exocytosis is impaired, release still fails while downstream PFC/NAc circuits flood with high-frequency glutamate noise and psychomotor agitation. Amphetamine/Desoxyn triggers PKC-mediated DAT reverse efflux (~4x methylphenidate's DA lift), resolving hypodopaminergia so H_NMDA shuts off—producing paradoxical physical calm, sleepiness, and high cortical SNR. Pure NDRIs (methylphenidate, NET > DAT) fail release-deficit brains, splitting noradrenergic tension from unresolved glutamate agitation. Benzodiazepines crush protective NMDA drive globally, unmasking severe hypotension and hypersomnia ('calm and nonfunctional'), whereas mild open-channel NMDA antagonism (amantadine) trims excess noise without GABA sedation when paired with a stimulant.
articles.epistemic_notes: Rishik Pannala's testable mechanistic hypothesis separating release-deficit NMDA-compensated ADHD (calmed across stimulant classes) from misdiagnosed typical stimulation or non-compensated MDD.

articles.title: An Analysis of Four Good Days: Opioid Adaptation, KOR & rACC Anosognosia
articles.core_mechanism: MOR activation (Gi -> inhibits adenylyl cyclase/cAMP/PKA, opens GIRK K+ channels, suppresses LC-NE and Substance P, and disinhibits VTA DA by hyperpolarizing GABA interneurons) triggers fierce counter-adaptation: GRK2/beta-arrestin2 receptor internalization, compensatory adenylyl cyclase/cAMP superactivation (unmasked violently in detox), CDK5/DARPP-32 Thr75-P dopamine dampening, and CREB-driven prodynorphin -> kappa-opioid receptor (KOR / lateral habenula) anti-reward dysphoria. Striatal DAT drops 31-35%, vmPFC/NAc shrink, and rostral anterior cingulate cortex (rACC) gray-matter loss produces anosognosia—unbreakable overconfidence caused by a broken error-detection alarm rather than genuine resilience. Naltrexone competitively locks MOR out for 30 days (stronger affinity than fentanyl) but precipitates severe withdrawal if MOR agonists remain bound.
articles.epistemic_notes: Long-term 10-30 year opioid abstinence maintenance <30% and 6-20x standardized mortality ratio highlight structural persistence beyond acute 4-day detox.

articles.title: Why We Need Quantum Neuropharmacology — Not Classical Neuropharmacology
articles.core_mechanism: Classical planetary electrons would radiate and spiral into the nucleus in ~10^-11 seconds. Synaptic membranes and vesicles exist only through quantum London dispersion fluctuations in electron density clouds, and receptor selectivity is governed by frontier molecular orbital (HOMO/LUMO) electrostatics rather than rigid geometric lock-and-key cartoons. Unlearning entrenched classical heuristics is neurologically resisted because LTP-consolidated circuits are actively maintained by PKMzeta.
articles.epistemic_notes: Motivates explicit Kohn-Sham DFT (wB97X-D) frontier orbital, Fukui f+, and electrostatic potential analysis in rational CNS ligand design.

articles.title: ΔFosB Does Not Save Your Brain Energy. It Charges Rent.
articles.core_mechanism: Original computational structural & mathematical research by Rishik Pannala: (1) Cascade: DeltaFosB -> CDK5/p35 -> DARPP-32 Thr75-P inhibits PKA -> Thr34-P drops -> PP1 strips GluA1 Ser845-P while new D1 MSN spines receive cortical GLUTAMATE, not dopamine (amplified urge to act + dismantled value conversion). (2) Undruggability: Full-length DeltaFosB (P53539-11, 237 aa) has 0 non-covalent druggable pockets—Hendlich LIGSITE finds 18 A^3 static (42.7 A^3 mean, 173 A^3 max across 10 ns) vs 250 A^3 druggability floor and 368 A^3 HIV-1 protease (1HSG) control. Only the open C172/JunD-C285 redox switch (13.62 A in 5VPE -> 2.03 A unstrained 1.44 kcal/mol disulfide in 5VPB; 47.6 A^2 SASA) is touchable. Mild neutral benzofuranone phenacyl warheads (-9.9 to -11.4 kcal/mol, 5/5 CNS MPO) beat promiscuous maleimides (-34.2 kcal/mol) and BBB-excluded anionic 9OC3 sulfonates (3/5 CNS, TPSA 105-122 A^2). (3) Geometry & Metabolic Rent: Gauss-Bonnet pins integral(K dA) = 4*pi (chi=2), carrying zero spine info and canceling saddle-splay kappa-bar; Willmore W(S_N) = W_0 + N(4*pi + pi*L/2r) rises 18.80 -> 143.87 (neck-dominated, head-radius invariant). Installation (1.46e9 ATP) is repaid in 2-9 seconds against +2.3% to +9.9% continuous metabolic rent. (4) Non-Gradient Persistence Law: 3-attractor Freidlin-Wentzell loop residual is +1.73 != 0 (median |curl|/|b| = 1.38x, 960x asymmetry -> no scalar energy well exists). In Ito log-space dx = [f(A)/A - D]dt + sqrt(2D)dW with static-heterogeneity correction D = (1-phi)Var(x)k (phi ~ 0.70 prevents 3.3x D inflation), persistence obeys tau ~ rho^(alpha/D) = rho^23.3 (alpha = 0.649 d^-1, D = 0.0279 d^-1; ln(rho) R^2 = 0.845 vs cross-sectional fold-change R = A_hi/A_lo R^2 = 0.322). During abstinence d === 0 => E_d === 0 (driver/receptor blockade has identically ZERO leverage on established persistence), whereas self-reinforcement loop gain E_v = +21.8 (-10.6% v cuts 80d -> 7d) and noise E_D = -6.99 (+41.7% D cuts 80d -> 7d) dominate.
articles.epistemic_notes: [?] Explicit boundaries stated in Article 07: C172 pKa shift spans 8.1 units (-4.09 bare DFT vs +4.00 with 5 Cl- at GFN2) so no pKa sign/magnitude is claimed; 7UCD deposited MV0 lacks its reactive leaving group; GFN2 underestimates epoxide ring-opening by ~13 kcal/mol (-23.9 vs -37.1 kcal/mol DFT); DeltaE_rxn != k_inact/K_I; GluA2 upregulation vs late CP-AMPAR accumulation remains an unclosed timescale/compartment gap; metabolic rent linearity assumes adapted spines are not individually quieter; MD runs (1.06 ns explicit, 10 ns implicit) sample local fluctuations, and 12 designed candidates are unsynthesized computational hypotheses.

articles.title: An Analysis of Marshall and Kim: Two Runaways, the Songs, and What the Pills Left Behind
articles.core_mechanism: Dissects six interlocking human mechanisms: (1) Developmental CRF/HPA set-point sensitization wired into VTA/amygdala/NAc + social injury processed in physical-pain dACC/anterior insula tissue (blunted by acetaminophen; amygdala Substance P -> NK1 drives stress-craving). (2) Midbrain dopamine uncertainty signal peaking at 50/50 intermittent probability (4p(1-p) coin-flip schedules lock persistence harder than guaranteed reward). (3) Wanting vs Liking split: 99% NAc DA depletion spares sweet liking while abolishing wanting; pleasure lives in a 1 mm^3 rostrodorsal medial NAc shell MOR hotspot, and social separation cries run on the exact same endogenous MOR system that alcohol dumps (why naltrexone cuts drinking). (4) Hepatic transesterification of cocaine + ethanol forms cocaethylene—holding DAT while sparing the SERT brake, extending t_1/2 (~2h vs 1h), blocking cardiac hERG K+ channels ~3x harder, and raising sudden death risk 18-25x. (5) Ambien/Valium GABA-A (alpha1) potentiation causes hippocampal encoding failure (nothing written to retrieve, e.g., 2001 Lose Yourself scratch tape). (6) Methadone's lethal mismatch: 4-8h analgesia vs 8-59h elimination half-life causes Day 2-4 plasma accumulation + QTc Torsades + 3.86x overdose hazard with benzodiazepines (74% of methadone deaths). Seventeen-mile/day running swapped the input route while feeding the exact same D1/dynorphin DeltaFosB pool, alongside G9a repression, HDAC5 loss, and stalled ('cocked') RNA Pol II on the Fosb promoter.
articles.epistemic_notes: [?] Flags Porter-Stransky's D2 beta-arrestin2 knockout paradox (deleting D2 arrestin reduced rather than increased cocaine reward in mice) and notes human striatal arrestin/DeltaFosB measurements in polysubstance cases are inferred from rodent models.

articles.title: An Analysis of The Basketball Diaries: The Court, the Heat Wave, and How a Brain Dismantles a Kid
articles.core_mechanism: Chronological receptor-to-circuit dissection of The Basketball Diaries (1995) and Jim Carroll's descent: (1) Smoked nicotine hits α4β2/α6β2 nAChRs on VTA DA neurons in 7–10 s vs. 40–55 min for gum/patches; steep dC/dt drives phasic Ca2+-mediated DA bursts and striatal LTP. (2) Heroin (3,6-diacetylmorphine) is never sold orally because hepatic first-pass hydrolyzes it to polar morphine, preventing rapid BBB crossing and brain conversion into potent 6-MAM; the phenolic 3-OH anchors Asp147/TM5-6 while N-methyl leaves Trp293 free to swing TM6/TM7 outward, docking Gi/Go, dropping cAMP/PKA, opening GIRK K+ efflux to hyperpolarize LC NE and dorsal-horn nociceptors, and silencing VTA GABA interneurons to produce pure MOR hedonic-hotspot 'liking' ('a long heat wave'). (3) Abrupt clearance unmasks cAMP superactivation, hyperactive LC NE flooding α1A adrenoceptors (which lack C-terminal phosphorylation barcodes for β-arrestin2/clathrin internalization), Substance P/NK1 pro-inflammatory agitation in MeA, CRF surge, and D1-MSN retrograde dynorphin/KOR suppression—producing bathroom rage and stripping cognitive empathy. (4) As compulsion accelerates through the candy-shop arrest of Pedro, Reggie's forced cold-turkey detox ('I just want to be pure'), Jim stealing Reggie's cash after surviving acute sickness, the public restroom, Mickey's α1A-hijacked rooftop fatality, and Jim's 3-second oscillation outside his mother's locked door (dACC/MOR separation distress + PFC shutdown), abstinence alone yields E_d === 0 because ΔFosB -> CDK5 -> DARPP-32 Thr75, stalled RNA Pol II, and CP-AMPA glutamate spines keep the adapted attractor intact (τ ∝ ρ^23.3) until six months of forced isolation at Rikers Island plus a new identity outside the old cue ecology lets him refuse Pedro's bag at the stage door.
articles.epistemic_notes: Preserves explicit mechanistic boundaries: subjective MOR 'liking' qualia remain an open hard problem beyond hedonic-hotspot localization; behavioral recovery across the Rikers Island/stage-door turning point is framed as a probabilistically rare-event separatrix crossing (τ ∝ ρ^23.3) rather than thermodynamic irreversibility.

articles.title: I Documented a Nobel Laureate's Narcissism While Reading His Book — And Got Addicted Anyway
articles.core_mechanism: Documents how grandiose status-framing followed by opaque, intimidating exercises hijacks reward/stress circuitry: initial awe triggers dopamine + MOR hedonic euphoria, while sudden failure/status-threat floods locus coeruleus norepinephrine onto lower-affinity prefrontal alpha1A adrenoceptors (PKC/cAMP -> opens Layer III HCN leak channels), shutting down PFC cognitive flexibility and weakening rACC metacognitive control. Pure non-hedonic dopamine compulsion ('wanting without liking' agony) traps the reader in repetitive failure. Stripping status reverence ('no-BS perspective') drops NE back into the high-affinity alpha2A window, closing HCN leaks and revealing that dense philosophical prose was burying elementary periodic/Fourier concepts.
articles.epistemic_notes: Biographical documentation cites Patchen Barss, The Impossible Man (2024); circuit mechanism connects Arnsten's prefrontal alpha2A/alpha1A switch to status-threat pedagogy.

equations.name: Itô Log-Space Synaptic Maintenance SDE (Article 07 §10.4)
equations.formula: dx = [f(e^x)/e^x - D] dt + sqrt(2D) dW, where x = ln(A), D = sigma_m^2 / 2, and f(A) = b_0 + d(t) + v*A^n/(K^n + A^n) - k_A*A
equations.meaning: Multiplicative spine fluctuations require logarithmic coordinates; the -D Itô drift term shifts effective fixed points to f(A)/A = D.

equations.name: Static Heterogeneity vs Dynamic Fluctuation Deconfounding (Article 07 §10.4)
equations.formula: D = (1 - phi) * Var(x) * k, where phi = Var(s) / (Var(s) + Var(d)) ~ 0.70
equations.meaning: Autocorrelation plateau phi ~ 0.70 reflects static between-synapse/person differences; omitting (1 - phi) inflates D by 3.3x and severely understates persistence.

equations.name: Separatrix Power-Law Persistence & Elasticities (Article 07 §10.4)

During abstinence d === 0, so receptor/driver blockade has identically zero leverage on established state duration; cutting loop gain v by 10.6% or raising fluctuation D by 41.7% cuts 80d persistence to ~7d.
